git.working_tree: dirty (closeout work in progress; nothing committed)

scope.claim: Local build + browser acceptance of the three-frontend origin. NOT a live-service certification: nothing was deployed, and no live DNS, Cloudflare Worker or GitHub Pages target was exercised.
not_covered: live DNS for the branded worker domains

build.note: All three built from the SAME pinned kit revision the deploy workflow uses; window.__ENV__ was injected with the same payloads deploy.yml injects, so the served build carries the effective configuration a deploy would ship.

harness.server: python3 static server on 0.0.0.0:8181 with a GitHub-Pages-equivalent 404.html fallback

deliberate_stubs.why: The lab origin is plain HTTP and non-localhost, so Chrome withholds this secure-context API. Both Leptos clients call register() during boot and abort on the TypeError. The stub records the URL each client would register (evidenced in probe.sw_registered) so the surface can be observed. The real origin is HTTPS and unaffected.
The build carries the PRODUCTION relay URL and agent pubkey. Blocking the socket exercises the Talk-to-AI disconnected path without sending any DM to the live agent.
